headlines.title: 上半年全国社会物流总额超180万亿元
headlines.summary: 中国物流与采购联合会今天（29日）公布今年上半年物流运行数据。上半年，物流需求规模持续扩大，结构优化与动能转换特征突出。今年上半年，全国社会物流总额181.1万亿元，同比增长5.1%，高于同期GDP增速0.4个百分点，物流需求对国民经济增长的支撑引领作用持续增强。分季度看，一、二季度分别增长6.2%、4.4%，总体呈现稳中有增的发展态势。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: First-half national social logistics total exceeds 180 trillion yuan
headlines.summary_en: China Logistics and Purchasing Federation announced today (29th) the first-half logistics data. In H1, logistics demand scale continued to expand, with notable structural optimization and momentum transformation. Total social logistics amounted to 181.1 trillion yuan in H1, up 5.1% year-on-year, 0.4 percentage points higher than GDP growth, showing sustained support for the national economy. By quarter, Q1 grew 6.2% and Q2 grew 4.4%, reflecting a stable and increasing trend. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 黄仁勋与美国商务部长会面，讨论四年在美生产5000亿美元技术产品
headlines.summary: 7 月 29 日，英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋周二与美国商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克会面。黄仁勋此行旨在与两党领导人会面，讨论英伟达四年内在美国本土生产价值 5000 亿美元技术产品以强化国家供应链的计划，以及美国在 AI 领域的领导地位，包括在开源方面的领先优势。黄仁勋本周在华盛顿的行程还包括与参议院情报委员会首席民主党议员马克·华纳及其他两党国会议员会面。与此同时，特朗普政府正敲定一项新框架，要求最先进的 AI 模型在发布前须向美国政府提供早期访问权限，并正在权衡对开源 AI 的政策立场。

headlines.title_en: Jensen Huang meets with U.S. Commerce Secretary; discusses producing $500 billion in tech products in the U.S. over four years
headlines.summary_en: On July 29, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang met with U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick on Tuesday. Huang's trip aims to meet with bipartisan leaders to discuss NVIDIA's plan to produce $500 billion in technology products in the U.S. over four years to strengthen the national supply chain, and U.S. leadership in AI, including its lead in open-source development. Huang's Washington itinerary this week also includes meetings with Senator Mark Warner, the top Democrat on the Senate Intelligence Committee, and other bipartisan lawmakers. Meanwhile, the Trump administration is finalizing a new framework requiring the most advanced AI models to provide early access to the U.S. government before release, and is weighing policy stances on open-source AI.
